quotes: > **Implementation Status (2026-11-21, `42700e1` / `9dfec4a`):** `horizon_gfa`, `horizon_lift`, `horizon_clean`, `horizon_resolve` (`u32` `PackedGraph` + $O(V+E)$ Tarjan biedged snarl decomposition + topological window-divergence heuristic), `horizon_filter` (streaming PAF SDUST+MDL filter & netter), `horizon_locus` (regional `impg`-style multi-FASTA locus aligner), `horizon_wga --graph` (seeded DAG/POA MDL DP in `src/mdl/dag.rs` with `MASK_W10`, `MASK_RY20`, and `aa5_keys` 6-frame translated fallback), `src/io_util.rs` (plain, `.gz`/`.bgz`, `.zst`/`.zstd` via `zstd` CLI, `stdin`/`stdout`), `src/paf.rs`, `src/gfa/mod.rs` (`SpoolableGfaInput`), `src/coord.rs`, `src/seeding/flat_index.rs`, and MDL-calibrated `src/egraph.rs` (`MdlCostModel`) are implemented (**120** passing unit tests: `86` lib + `34` bin, `1` ignored; `11` suite binaries + `bench_chr1` in `src/bin/`). Note that `stream_gfa` parses `S`/`L`/`P`/`W` records while skipping `C`/`J` records and defaulting empty `L` orientations to `+`.

* Active both inside `horizon_wga --resolve-dups` (emitting `# EG:Z:` tags) and as standalone `horizon_resolve` (`src/bin/horizon_resolve.rs`), which streams GFA v1.0/v1.1 `P`/`W` lines in two passes into a `u32`-interned `PackedGraph`, decomposes graphs via $O(V + E)$ Tarjan biedged snarl decomposition, estimates window divergence via a topological `[0.02, 0.15]` heuristic (with optional `--divergence` override), cancels double inversions, detects/collapses adjacent tandem duplications (`--collapse-dups`, `--tag-walks`), updates `W`-line `end` bounds, and prunes/synthesizes `L` links (assuming `0M` overlaps).

* **`horizon_filter` (`src/bin/horizon_filter.rs`, `src/paf.rs`):** Streams `.paf[.gz|.zst]` or `stdin`, evaluates alignments with SDUST repeat masking (`--min-nonrepeat-bp`) and Pair-HMM MDL bit-savings using contig-global or fixed `0.5` GC `base_probs` (`md:f:` / `hb:i:`), and optionally nets overlapping alignments (`--net` / `--max-occ`).

* **`horizon_locus` (`src/bin/horizon_locus.rs`):** Aligns all pairs in a regional `impg`-style multi-FASTA (`.fa[.gz|.zst]`) using `SDUST + BOCPD/MDL + Aa5Index`, emitting `<out>.similarity.tsv` (`jaccard_cov` average covered fraction, `p_dist` and `jc69_dist` over aligned bases clamped at `0.74`, Horizon Bubbles), `<out>.maf`, and `<out>.gfa`.

quotes: Pairwise WGA results use the divergence-adaptive Pair-HMM (`HmmParams`: `identity_prior`, `gap_open_bits`, and `gap_extend_bits` estimated from LCB anchors with Beta prior shrinkage in `src/mdl/mod.rs`), BOCPD compositional profiles (`src/bocpd.rs`, ignoring non-ACGT `'N'` bases), composition-aware BOCPD LCB gating (`joint_pair_bits - GAP_OPEN_BITS` across all LCB lengths in `src/mdl/mod.rs`), and normalized Pair-HMM transitions (`src/mdl/dp.rs`, `src/mdl/dag.rs`), including `mdl_xdrop_extend_with_params` and `horizon_wga --graph` (`estimate_dag_hmm_params` calibrates `gap_open_bits`/`gap_extend_bits` from adjacent seed pairs, and `align_seq_to_dag_seeded` uses bp-budgeted component-isolated subgraph extraction). Note that `KARLIN_MDL_COEFF = 0.55` remains a fixed constant, and MAF-extracted FASTAs sample homologous blocks (`horizon_eval` evaluates reference-MAF `(ref_id, tgt_id)` contig pairs individually rather than all-vs-all across scaffolds). All benchmarks below are pinned to their respective commits (`8cd5db0` / `2896229` for core WGA & HPRC, `42700e1` / `9dfec4a` for VGP `horizon_filter` & `horizon_locus`), including a head-to-head `vg v1.60.0` comparison on a real 10,000-segment HPRC `chr22` subgraph, the **B10K 363-way** avian slice (`Gallus_gallus` vs `Taeniopygia_guttata`), and a base-level coordinate concordance evaluation of full `GRCh38.chr6` × `CHM13.chr6` against both the HPRC Minigraph-Cactus graph and `minimap2 -x asm5` (`v2.28-r1209`; `odgi`/`LASTZ` remain unavailable on this host).

quotes: > **Implementation Status (2026-11-21, `42700e1` / `9dfec4a`):** `horizon_gfa`, `horizon_lift`, `horizon_clean`, `horizon_resolve` (`u32` `PackedGraph` + $O(V+E)$ Tarjan biedged snarl decomposition + topological window-divergence heuristic), `horizon_filter` (streaming PAF SDUST+MDL filter & netter), `horizon_locus` (regional `impg`-style multi-FASTA locus aligner), `horizon_wga --graph` (seeded DAG/POA MDL DP in `src/mdl/dag.rs` with `MASK_W10`, `MASK_RY20`, and `aa5_keys` 6-frame translated fallback), `src/io_util.rs` (plain, `.gz`/`.bgz`, `.zst`/`.zstd` via `zstd` CLI, `stdin`/`stdout`), `src/paf.rs`, `src/gfa/mod.rs` (`SpoolableGfaInput`), `src/coord.rs`, `src/seeding/flat_index.rs`, and MDL-calibrated `src/egraph.rs` (`MdlCostModel`) are implemented (**120** passing unit tests: `86` lib + `34` bin, `1` ignored; `11` suite binaries + `bench_chr1` in `src/bin/`). Note that `stream_gfa` parses `S`/`L`/`P`/`W` records while skipping `C`/`J` records and defaulting empty `L` orientations to `+`.

* Active both inside `horizon_wga --resolve-dups` (emitting `# EG:Z:` tags) and as standalone `horizon_resolve` (`src/bin/horizon_resolve.rs`), which streams GFA v1.0/v1.1 `P`/`W` lines in two passes into a `u32`-interned `PackedGraph`, decomposes graphs via $O(V + E)$ Tarjan biedged snarl decomposition, estimates window divergence via a topological `[0.02, 0.15]` heuristic (with optional `--divergence` override), cancels double inversions, detects/collapses adjacent tandem duplications (`--collapse-dups`, `--tag-walks`), updates `W`-line `end` bounds, and prunes/synthesizes `L` links (assuming `0M` overlaps).

* **`horizon_filter` (`src/bin/horizon_filter.rs`, `src/paf.rs`):** Streams `.paf[.gz|.zst]` or `stdin`, evaluates alignments with SDUST repeat masking (`--min-nonrepeat-bp`) and Pair-HMM MDL bit-savings using contig-global or fixed `0.5` GC `base_probs` (`md:f:` / `hb:i:`), and optionally nets overlapping alignments (`--net` / `--max-occ`).

* **`horizon_locus` (`src/bin/horizon_locus.rs`):** Aligns all pairs in a regional `impg`-style multi-FASTA (`.fa[.gz|.zst]`) using `SDUST + BOCPD/MDL + Aa5Index`, emitting `<out>.similarity.tsv` (`jaccard_cov` average covered fraction, `p_dist` and `jc69_dist` over aligned bases clamped at `0.74`, Horizon Bubbles), `<out>.maf`, and `<out>.gfa`.
